verdict: FAIL_CLOSED. The M2054 two-stop hybrid concept is structurally viable, the two UCLI scripts select one mapped implementation each, and the final UCLI run would resume the frozen M2051 test through its functional PASS. The reviewed source cannot be compiled or trusted as a matched energy experiment, however: neither filelist contains its mapped netlist; every unpacked [0:N] array is packed in the opposite direction from the DC netlist; the default full40 fixture slot 0 is layer 8/G6 while the source labels it layer 28/G48; and the PTPX script does not explicitly load the SSG library referenced by the mapped SDC before overriding to TT. Runtime workload identity, the 383-cycle preload invariant, continuous X/Z rejection, and axis/design/scope/cycle identity are also not self-enforcing. No one-shot runner is authorized for the M2054 source hashes sealed here. An additive successor may repair the sources and must receive a fresh independent source hammer before any VCS, PTPX, or license use.

positive_checks.ucli_run_stop_sequence: run; enable; run; disable/report; run; quit

findings.finding: Both nine-line filelists include the standard-cell model, M803 RTL, M2018 RTL, the hybrid adapter, SVA and testbenches, but neither includes the corresponding M2029 mapped Verilog. The adapter therefore references an undefined SCHEDULE_MODE0 or SCHEDULE_MODE1 mapped top and VCS elaboration must fail unless an unsealed command-line source is injected outside the filelist.
findings.required_repair: Each successor filelist must contain exactly one exact-SHA mapped Verilog: ordinary gets only the mode-0 netlist and TSBG gets only the mode-1 netlist. The runner must not append an identity-shadow source.

findings.finding: The adapter maps bank 0/lane 0 to the low packed bits. DC serialized every ascending unpacked [0:N] dimension in the opposite outer order. Static mapped-netlist evidence is decisive: original adapter_slot_weight_q_reg_0__0__0__0_ is loaded from mem_rsp_weight[1016], whereas adapter_slot_weight_q_reg_7__7__15__0_ is loaded from mem_rsp_weight[0]. The current adapter would reverse bank/lane ownership and also reverses bridge and commit lane arrays.
findings.required_repair: Use (7-bank) for every eight-bank [0:7] packed segment, (15-lane) inside every [0:15] lane segment, and (15-lane)*24 for commit_accumulator. Preserve bit order inside each packed element. Apply the same rule to request metadata, response metadata/payload, bridge metadata/value/effective-weight and commit outputs.

findings.finding: The wrapper defaults and prints workload_slot=0, while the PTPX scope file calls it layer28/G48. The frozen full40 stats prove global slot 0 is sample 0, layer 8, FC1, token 0, six real source groups, with 23 rows/222 issues/6912 products. Layer 28/G48 begins at global slot 42. The sealed M2050 slot-0 run reports 3184 ordinary and 1043 TSBG execution cycles, not the layer-28 numbers.
findings.required_repair: Choose and lock one identity. If successor policy keeps global slot 0, label it exactly ep34 full40 sample0/layer8/FC1/token0/G6 and fix cycles at 3184/1043. Do not call it G48 or layer28.

findings.finding: The PTPX link_path contains only the TT DB, but each mapped SDC executes set_operating_conditions and set_wire_load_model against library tcbn28hpcplusbwp35p140ssg0p9v125c before the script overrides the corner to TT. The required SSG library is not explicitly loaded or linked.
findings.required_repair: Pin an SSG DB input, make TT and SSG visible before read_sdc, then explicitly reapply TT0.9V25C and ZeroWireload after read_sdc.

findings.finding: M2051 accepts any WORKLOAD_SLOT plusarg from 0 to 1919. The wrapper prints a literal slot 0 and never checks core.workload_slot or the decoded sample/layer/is_fc2/token/source-group metadata. A different run can silently receive a slot-0 label.
findings.required_repair: At the first stop, fail unless core.workload_slot and every frozen metadata/counter expectation equal the selected slot. The one-shot command must not accept an arbitrary workload plusarg.

findings.finding: The two-stop wrapper prints preload_cycles=383 but does not derive or assert that duration. Its first stop is correctly placed after full_execute_start_cycle and before the next core clock, but a future load-handshake drift could preserve the literal receipt while changing the window.
findings.required_repair: Capture the reset-complete/load-begin cycle or assert the frozen full_execute_start_cycle invariant and match it to 383 before the first stop. The final checker must also reconcile SAIF start/end duration with the fixed axis execution cycles.

findings.finding: The selected public interface is checked immediately before the first stop and again at selected completion, but there is no every-clock monitor while SAIF is active. The reused SVA has no general knownness property, so a transient mapped X/Z can contaminate activity and resolve before the second endpoint check.
findings.required_repair: Maintain an explicit window_active bit and call a selected-axis public-known checker on every core clock throughout the measurement window. Fail before reporting SAIF on any X/Z.

findings.finding: PTPX independently trusts M2054_AXIS, M2054_DESIGN_NAME, M2054_SAIF_INSTANCE and M2054_MEASUREMENT_CYCLES. It allows either design but never proves the selected axis implies the corresponding design, UCLI hierarchy, mapped netlist/SDC, and fixed 3184 or 1043 cycle count.
findings.required_repair: Derive design, strip path and cycle count from one exact axis value inside the TCL or a sealed runner; reject all contradictory environment combinations and reconcile the simulation PASS/SAIF duration.

findings.finding: If both axis defines are present, the first ifdef silently wins. The current two filelists each provide only one define, but the adapter itself does not prove mutual exclusion.
findings.required_repair: Add an explicit both-defined preprocessor error or make the runner's exact filelist identity the sole compile authority.

findings.finding: Several scalar/vector signals are placed in one aggregate isunknown expression, which fails closed but does not identify the exact bit or signal. This repeats part of the M1854 diagnosability weakness.
findings.required_repair: Keep fail-closed behavior and emit the first offending signal/bank/lane in the successor monitor so a consumed attempt can be diagnosed without retry.
